ids.description: Report ids to mark. Give one way to pick reports: ids, group, or a filter.

group.description: A group id from friction_find. Marks every report in the group.

project.description: Project name for a filter. Use with area or text.

text.description: Text the reports must contain, without regard to case.

link.description: A change id such as ch_1234, or a web address. A mark without a link clears the old one.

note.description: One line of at most 200 characters. A mark without a note clears the old one.

dry_run.description: Count the matches and write nothing.
